stories.headline: PHP cyber-security warning sees sites taken down across Europe
stories.description: Two critical vulnerabilities have been identified in PHP, a widely used programming language.

stories.headline: US congressional candidate Brad Lander freed after West Bank detention
stories.description: Lander says dozens remain in Israeli custody after being detained while helping Palestinian farmers harvest olives.

stories.headline: How Qatar, Turkiye, Pakistan and Indonesia are deepening defence ties
stories.description: Experts say conflicts and uncertainty are accelerating efforts to strengthen regional military capacity.

stories.headline: How Israel’s war on Lebanon has cost young people with autism and ADHD
stories.description: Experts warn that war takes a heavy toll on neurodivergent people, who often rely on routine.

stories.headline: Are the UK, France being pulled into the Saudi-Houthi conflict?
stories.description: The European states say their support for Riyadh is ‘defensive’, but analysts warn Houthi reaction may complicate that.
